promises.label: FMEG margin 8-10% by FY30

promises.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya

promises.label: Fan price hikes 2-4%
promises.quote: the price hikes would be in the range of 2% to 4% and which will be taken during the course of first 1-1.5 months
promises.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya

reported.label: Domestic C&W growth 59%

reported.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya

reported.label: C&W profitability growth 34%
reported.quote: we were able to deliver 34% profitability growth in this segment
reported.speaker: Chirayu Upadhyaya

reported.quote: close to ₹ 6,000 crores worth of inventory, right, raw material plus finished goods
